title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cannot open source file "raylib.h"` | vcpkg installed for another platform, or not integrated | Set the platform to x64; run `vcpkg integrate install` | 1.01 |
| `LNK2019` for `InitWindow` or other raylib functions | raylib's library is not linked | Use vcpkg's integration, or add `raylib.lib` plus `winmm.lib` | 1.01 |
| A crash or black texture when loading at start-up | `LoadTexture` called before `InitWindow` | Load assets after `InitWindow` | 2.01 |
| Textures are white or missing when started outside Visual Studio | Relative paths and a different working directory | `ChangeDirectory(GetApplicationDirectory())` and copy the assets next to the .exe | 2.01, 6.02 |
| Moving objects leave trails | The frame is not cleared | `ClearBackground` at the start of every frame | 1.02 |
| The game runs faster on a fast screen | Movement per frame instead of per second | Multiply by `GetFrameTime()` | 1.04 |
| Diagonal movement is too fast | The direction is not normalised | Normalise the input direction | 1.04 |
| A menu choice jumps several items per key press | `IsKeyDown` used for a one-off action | `IsKeyPressed` | 1.05 |
| The character creeps with the gamepad untouched | Stick drift | A dead zone | 1.05 |
| An animation is stuck on its first frame | `play` restarts the animation every frame | Restart only when the animation changes | 2.02 |
| The music plays for a moment and stops | `UpdateMusicStream` is not called every frame | Call it every frame | 2.04 |
| A rapidly repeated sound cuts itself off | `PlaySound` restarts a Sound that is playing | Sound aliases | 2.04 |
| "Play again" starts with old enemies or score | State not reset | Reset the whole game state: `game = Game{};` | 2.05 |
| Characters catch on the seams between floor tiles | Collision resolved on both axes at once | Move and resolve one axis at a time | 3.02 |
| Bullets pass through thin walls | Tunnelling | Clamp dt, sub-steps or a swept test | 3.02 |
| Jumps reach different heights on different computers | Variable time step | A fixed time step | 3.04 |
| The game freezes after a slow frame | The spiral of death | Limit steps per frame or clamp the frame time | 3.04 |
| The interface scrolls with the world | Drawn inside `BeginMode2D` | Draw it after `EndMode2D` | 2.03, 4.01 |
| Clicks select the wrong object in a scrolled world | Mouse position used without the camera | `GetScreenToWorld2D` | 4.01 |
| Thin lines between tiles when zoomed | Rounding and filtering at tile edges | Whole-pixel positions, point filtering, extruded tile sheets | 4.02 |
| The view flips when looking straight up | Pitch not clamped | Clamp pitch to ±89° | 5.02 |
| A render texture is drawn upside down | OpenGL textures are flipped | Negative source height | 5.05 |
| A light shader's light is mirrored vertically | `gl_FragCoord` measures y from the bottom | Pass `screenHeight - y` | 5.04 |
| Shader changes have no effect | The shader failed to compile and raylib fell back to the default | Read the compile error in the log | 5.04 |
| Settings or saves are not written in Program Files | Windows does not allow writing there | Save in `%APPDATA%` | 6.01 |
| No sound in the web build | Browsers start audio only after a user action | A "click to start" screen | 6.02 |
